notes:
SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.105

Customer Payments → Invoices lists every open invoice in QuickBooks as of the last sync, oldest due first. Each row shows how late the invoice is, the customer, the type, the P.O. / memo, and the amount and open balance, including any part covered by payments not yet in QuickBooks.
Filters: search, how late, due between two dates and customer type, with the count and open total shown above the list.
Record payment on a row opens Record payment for that customer. Search finds the page as “invoices”, “unpaid” or “receivables”.
